brief: Builds the five standard reports of an org chart: summary, vacancy, succession, compliance and span of control.
detail: It takes a snapshot of the chart when it is built, so a position added later is not reported. Each report is a hash list with a title and its figures; stzOrgChart.GenerateReport and its aliases build a fresh reporter on every call, which is the usual way to reach it.
receiver: oc = new stzOrgChart("TechCo"); oc.AddExecutiveXT("ceo", "CEO"); oc.AddManagerXT("vp", "VP Sales"); oc.ReportsTo("vp", "ceo"); oc.AddPersonXT("p1", "Alice"); oc.AssignPerson("p1", "ceo"); o1 = new stzOrgChartReporter(oc)
